methodologyEn: Each year contains four editorial hot selections and two collector or seasonal-capsule selections. Dated Lyst product signals and contemporaneous fashion coverage support the hot edit; it is not a universal annual sales ranking. Model-family heat can be represented by a precisely identified current variant, with its photograph, size, material and price evidence specified separately. Limited-edition labels require explicit brand evidence. Season-specific special capsules retain that narrower label, without an invented production count. Prices distinguish live U.S. retail, indexed retail references and reported historical launch figures. All descriptions and styling text are original English editorial writing.

years.headlineEn: Long lines, soft structure and collectible play
years.introEn: Our 2024 edit moves from the elongated Le Teckel and tactile suede Arcadie to the relaxed Rodeo and geometric Puzzle Fold. Two special capsules add another register: Tyler, the Creator’s hand-drawn Louis Vuitton motifs and Fendi’s beaded tribute to Dragon-type Pokémon. Each selection has a dated reason for belonging to the year.

Smooth calfskin keeps the surface quiet enough for that shape to lead, while a double zipper and a removable interior mirror add useful detail. This medium black reference offers a particularly clear expression of the design: precise, compact and easy to imagine moving between a tailored daytime wardrobe and a more minimal evening look.

Double zip closure with a removable mirror inside the pocket.

Diagonal panels animate the Warm Desert calfskin, giving an otherwise clean surface a distinct sense of construction. The medium version is designed to collapse flat, an appealing detail for packing and storage, while long handles allow shoulder or hand carry. Its warm color offers an expressive alternative within a neutral wardrobe, and the open silhouette invites the kind of uncomplicated styling that makes a daily bag feel personal.

Medium tote with shoulder or hand carry.

Multicolored flowers interrupt the familiar brown canvas, while natural-toned handles and leather bands preserve the silhouette’s travel-bag character. It is a vivid record of the Spring 2024 collaboration: recognizable Louis Vuitton construction filtered through an artist’s hand-drawn marks and a palette that feels almost confectionery.

Compact Keepall 25 with leather handles, zip closure and adjustable strap.
